# @ic-reactor/vite-plugin

> Vite plugin that generates typed declarations, a reactor with bound React
> hooks, and optionally one query or mutation object per method from `.did`
> files, regenerates on change, and gives `vite dev` the local canister ids
> and an `/api` proxy to the local replica.

Applies to `@ic-reactor/vite-plugin` 0.15.0.

Read this file from `node_modules/@ic-reactor/vite-plugin/llms.txt` when
writing code against the installed version. The complete guide for every
package is https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt, and behaviour changes
are in https://github.com/B3Pay/ic-reactor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add -D @ic-reactor/vite-plugin
pnpm add @ic-reactor/react @icp-sdk/core @tanstack/react-query
```

## Setup and Usage

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from "vite"
import { icReactor } from "@ic-reactor/vite-plugin"

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const env = loadEnv(mode, process.cwd(), "")
  return {
    plugins: [
      icReactor({
        // outDir: "src/declarations" and clientManagerPath: "../../clients"
        // by default, so src/clients.ts must export `clientManager`
        canisters: [
          {
            name: "backend",
            didFile: "./backend/backend.did",
            factories: true, // also a query or mutation object per method
            // Used under `vite dev` too, in place of the local id
            canisterId: env.CANISTER_ID_BACKEND,
          },
        ],
      }),
    ],
  }
})
```

```tsx
// src/App.tsx: the generated entry is src/declarations/backend/index.ts
import { getPostsQuery, useBackendMutation } from "./declarations/backend"

export function Posts() {
  const { data: posts } = getPostsQuery.useQuery()
  const create = useBackendMutation({
    functionName: "create_post",
    invalidateQueries: [getPostsQuery],
  })
  return (
    <button onClick={() => create.mutate(["Hello"])}>
      {posts?.length ?? 0} posts
    </button>
  )
}
```

`src/clients.ts` is yours:
`export const clientManager = new ClientManager({ queryClient })`, with
`ClientManager` from `@ic-reactor/react` and a `QueryClient` from
`@tanstack/react-query` (set `retry: reactorRetry` in its query defaults).
For Internet Identity sign-in, build
`new AuthenticationManager({ clientManager })` in the same module and export
`useAuth` from `createAuthHooks(authentication)`; every generated reactor on
that `clientManager` then calls as the signed-in user.

## When to Use What

| Need                                              | Use                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Vite app, `.did` files in the repo                | this plugin                                            |
| No Vite, or generation as a CI step               | `@ic-reactor/cli`                                      |
| Query and mutation objects per method             | `factories: true` on the canister entry                |
| Raw Candid values instead of display values       | `mode: "Reactor"` on the canister entry                |
| No React                                          | `target: "core"`                                       |
| Local canister ids and `/api` proxy in `vite dev` | `injectEnvironment` (on by default)                    |
| A project without a local network                 | `injectEnvironment: false`, so page loads run no `icp` |

## Options

- Plugin level: `canisters` (required), `outDir`, `clientManagerPath`,
  `target`, `injectEnvironment`, `failOnError`.
- Per canister: `name` and `didFile` (required), `outDir`,
  `clientManagerPath`, `target`, `mode`, `canisterId`, `factories`. Relative
  paths resolve against Vite's `root`.
- `failOnError` defaults to `true` under `vite build` and `false` under
  `vite dev`, where a failure goes to the terminal and the browser overlay.
- Each entry needs its own output directory: a later entry with the same
  `name` and `outDir` as an earlier one fails.

## Generated Files

Per canister, under `<outDir>/<name>/`: `declarations/` (`idlFactory` and
`_SERVICE`), `index.generated.ts` (`<name>Reactor` and six hooks
`use<Name>Query`, `use<Name>Mutation`, ...), `index.factories.generated.ts`
with `factories: true` (`<method>Query`, `<method>Mutation`), and `index.ts`,
which is created once and then yours. Generation runs on startup and on every
`.did` change. An edited `index.ts` gets a terminal warning until it
re-exports `./index.factories.generated`; a warning never fails the build.

## Local Environment (`injectEnvironment`)

- Under `vite dev` and `vite preview` the plugin sets the `ic_env` cookie
  (root key, Internet Identity provider, `PUBLIC_CANISTER_ID:<name>`) on each
  response and proxies `/api` to the network `icp` reports.
- While `icp` reports no network or a configured canister has no id, each page
  load asks `icp` again, so deploying after `vite dev` started needs only a
  reload. Once every canister resolves, page loads run no `icp` command, and a
  redeploy into a fresh network needs a restart.
- An `/api` proxy set by the Vite config or another plugin is left alone.
- `ClientManager` trusts the cookie only on loopback and `localhost` hosts. A
  dev build served over a tunnel, Codespaces, Gitpod or a custom domain needs
  `allowEnvConfig: true` on the `ClientManager`; without it a generated
  reactor with no `canisterId` throws instead of reading one from the cookie.
- The cookie does not exist in production: set `canisterId` on every entry
  whose build is served anywhere else. A set `canisterId` is written into the
  generated reactor and wins over the local id under `vite dev` too, so take
  it from the environment (`loadEnv`, as above) when the local and production
  ids differ, rather than hard-coding the production id.
- Vitest runs `vite.config.ts` unless a `vitest.config.ts` replaces it, so
  the plugin generates again when tests run, in mode `test`. Set the
  `canisterId` variable for that mode too (for example in `.env.test`), or
  the regenerated reactor has no id and importing it in a test throws
  `canisterId is required`.

## Do Not

- Edit `index.generated.ts`, `index.factories.generated.ts` or
  `declarations/`; edit the `.did` or the plugin options.
- Hand-write per-method `createQuery` / `createMutation` modules; set
  `factories: true` and customize in `index.ts`.
- Rely on the `ic_env` cookie outside local development.
- Point two entries at one output directory.
- Import generated modules into a React Server Component, or use them per
  request on a server: they are module scope and import hooks.
